verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents admin-configurable retention schedules, automatic deletion of transcripts or recordings, or an on-demand permanent erase capability. The '0-day data retention policy' covers Fireflies' vendors and partners, not customer data lifecycle. The Rules Engine is described only as controlling 'meeting access and privacy'. Share expiry is an adjacent feature, not data deletion.

support.subject: As an IT admin, I can set retention policies — auto-delete transcripts and recordings on a schedule — and permanently erase data on demand
